original_case.required_behavior: Unknown strategy identity is not passed as the existing Early Leadership control
New source event without accepted B1 anchor stays a nomination, not a surrogate episode
Later source correction preserves earlier source-known decision belief
Historical event discovery reports current-manifest selection limits
Optional absent evidence differs from measured neutral and adverse evidence
Unpromoted model or computational availability cannot grant product trading authority
No parallel outcome/quote/geometry/thesis owner is introduced
Public availability, system capture, model vintage and user visibility remain separate
Actual and expectation with different fiscal periods are not compared as a beat
GAAP and issuer-adjusted values need explicit compatible definition
Currency, units, segment and share basis mismatch is disclosed
Absent/unlicensed consensus does not become zero or a statistical-forecast consensus
Contributor departure can change mean without a matched upward revision
No common contributor yields unmeasured matched revision, not zero
Fixed-period estimate changes are separated from forward-horizon roll
Near-zero/negative expectation does not manufacture a percent beat
Guidance withdrawal/range change is not an ordinary raise/cut scalar
Release, call, filing and later estimate observations use their own known clocks
Post-event revision cannot be substituted for pre-event expectation
Same-event correction does not mint a new independent opportunity
Post-release fill cannot earn the pre-fill announcement gap
Never-confirmed/no-pullback/unpriced events remain in the policy accounting
Next earnings event does not erase original forecast or reset its outcome horizon
Loss in a tactical/earnings trade cannot silently become a Cycle Capture position
Domain readiness is evaluated without selecting on future returns
Broad Census computers/electronics data is not labeled granular semiconductor evidence
Industry/segment membership and classifications are point-in-time or explicitly current-only
Revised industrial series cannot overwrite an original-vintage observation
Lower absolute inventory is distinguished from higher inventory relative to sales
Order cancellations and nominal-price effects are not unqualified demand improvement
Dated debt maturity can breach liquidity before headline cash runway expires
Restricted cash and conditional facilities cannot be assumed fully usable
Operating cash/obligations and financing proceeds are not double-counted
Higher enterprise value with dilution can lower per-share value
Original shares cancelled in restructuring do not inherit new-equity recovery
Joint recovery/funding/payoff is not a product of unverified independent scores
Future-smoothed economic state is excluded from live historical signal claims
Failed/delisted/censored cases and common-cycle dependence are retained
New-add chase refusal does not automatically terminate a valid core hold
Binding structural/funding invalidation cannot be waived by bullish narrative
Earnings drawer shows actual/prior/expectation basis and distinct source clocks
Cycle drawer shows funding milestone, assumptions and original-equity scenario
Uncalibrated forecasts render as unavailable/accruing, not invented probabilities
Watch saves only to selected existing list and verifies actual owner readback
Notes and episode actions are not falsely presented as cloud-persisted
Shared event across sleeves does not duplicate portfolio exposure or independent N
Rights/entitlement restrictions apply to numbers and generated explanations
Accepted source to entitled browser and subsequent ordinary refresh preserve correction/identity truth

cases.title: No hidden candidate deletion
cases.setup: A source-qualified nomination is cap-displaced or lacks a B1 anchor.
cases.required_behavior: Original source count, suppression and searchable observation remain; no surrogate episode or fabricated score.

cases.title: No surrogate identity
cases.setup: Two securities share an issuer or a ticker alias changes.
cases.required_behavior: Resolve exact security/epoch and B1 generation, not string equality or a newly synthesized ticker-date key.

cases.title: Corrected same-date source
cases.setup: Payload changes without a new market date.
cases.required_behavior: Coherent generation changes reach preview/private hydration; prior decision is preserved.

cases.title: Prior-session validity
cases.setup: Yesterday qualified technical source meets current RTH quote.
cases.required_behavior: Accepted explicit validity/expiry law or honest refusal, never relabeled source date.

cases.title: Expired or retracted validity
cases.setup: Previously valid entry facts expire or retract while UI remains open.
cases.required_behavior: Current action becomes unavailable with clear reason; old decision is retained as history.

cases.title: Historical event omissions
cases.setup: Current manifest lacks an old event previously in the universe.
cases.required_behavior: Historical study refuses full-event-population claim until owner history is qualified.

cases.title: Model vintage leakage
cases.setup: Modern model is run on old documents with unknowable training chronology.
cases.required_behavior: Extraction versus prediction class and retrospective status are explicit; no PIT forecasting certification from prompt dates.

cases.title: Optional intelligence missing
cases.setup: Options/estimates/transcript unavailable for a supported name.
cases.required_behavior: Base research remains useful with named missingness; mandatory entry fact absence still blocks action.

cases.title: Source rights to prose
cases.setup: Unlicensed consensus present in a worker or server-side context.
cases.required_behavior: No prohibited value leaks through anonymous JSON, generated narration or cached account responses.

cases.title: Self-generated group strength
cases.setup: One member drives an otherwise flat group.
cases.required_behavior: Peer-excluding-member control is distinct, with actual weights and no independent evidence double-credit.

cases.title: Historical member leakage
cases.setup: Today-known baskets omit failed historical constituents.
cases.required_behavior: PIT membership or explicit non-PIT limitation; no promotional historical inference on biased frame.

cases.title: Source granularity mismatch
cases.setup: Electronics aggregate is presented as memory-subtheme observation.
cases.required_behavior: Claim remains at real aggregate scope; unavailable granularity is disclosed.

cases.title: False consensus revision
cases.setup: Contributor exits while remaining estimates are unchanged.
cases.required_behavior: Aggregate change and matched revision reported separately; matched absence is unknown.

cases.title: Period and accounting mismatch
cases.setup: GAAP versus adjusted estimates or different fiscal dates are compared.
cases.required_behavior: No beat/miss unless exact comparable owner semantics established.

cases.title: Funding precedes recovery
cases.setup: Debt maturity falls before modeled recovery despite simple runway.
cases.required_behavior: Dated obligations reveal funding limit; scenario assumptions cannot be described as committed facilities.

cases.title: Old equity canceled
cases.setup: Business recovers after old shares canceled and new equity issued.
cases.required_behavior: Old security terminal value is preserved; no performance splice into replacement equity.

cases.title: Original and current predictions
cases.setup: Later favorable evidence appears on an existing episode.
cases.required_behavior: New landmark observation; original ranking/forecast remains immutable and visible.

cases.title: Rank is not probability
cases.setup: Rank relevance rises to a high value without calibration.
cases.required_behavior: UI labels rank/priority only; no win probability or return target invented.

cases.title: Selected-cohort calibration
cases.setup: Pooled model calibrated but displayed top-K poorly calibrated.
cases.required_behavior: Top-K/sleeve/horizon failure appears in qualification; no pooled-only confidence claim.

cases.title: Implicit confluence waiver
cases.setup: Earlier 1D/4H observation is used with unchanged EL control.
cases.required_behavior: No entry bypass; separate accepted early-entry policy and study are required.

cases.title: Missed confirmation denominator
cases.setup: Only eventual confirmers are retained in early-entry evaluation.
cases.required_behavior: Evaluator rejects selected population and preserves all original opportunities.

cases.title: Price-row/session mismatch
cases.setup: Missing daily bars shift a positional horizon.
cases.required_behavior: Expected session endpoint and actual coverage differ visibly; no silent H10-session label.

cases.title: Unknown path versus cash
cases.setup: Unpriced episode and known no-entry policy share a report.
cases.required_behavior: Unpriced remains unknown; only valid no-entry follows declared cash accounting.

cases.title: Ambiguous barrier order
cases.setup: Same OHLC bar crosses both target and invalidation.
cases.required_behavior: Order unresolved without actual finer evidence; conservative sensitivity is labeled assumption.

cases.title: Entry MAE versus giveback
cases.setup: Path rallies then falls sharply while above entry.
cases.required_behavior: Entry adverse excursion, peak drawdown and realized capture remain distinct metrics.

cases.title: Row-count leakage
cases.setup: Thousands of rows/date are split with a small sample gap.
cases.required_behavior: Whole dates/episodes and outcome intervals define split; immature labels do not train.

cases.title: Duplicate policies and repeated instants
cases.setup: Identical configurations and many ticks inflate apparent sample count.
cases.required_behavior: Explicit semantic aliases and dependence; no new independent episode or test credit.

cases.title: No-harm fallacy
cases.setup: Wide interval includes zero and material downside.
cases.required_behavior: Declared non-inferiority bound fails or remains inconclusive; absence of significance does not pass.

cases.title: Mature stock new-entry refusal
cases.setup: Held position remains valid but a new entry would chase.
cases.required_behavior: New-entry and held-position actions differ correctly; no automatic exit from RAN.

cases.title: Retroactive strategy change
cases.setup: Losing tactical position is retitled Cycle Capture.
cases.required_behavior: Original strategy persists; any new thesis is explicit and cannot rewrite its old outcome.

cases.title: Focus-safe update
cases.setup: User reviews a row as rank generation updates.
cases.required_behavior: Selection/focus preserved; update offered; material invalidation still visible without stale action.

cases.title: Art directions and language
cases.setup: 1440/390 EN/ZH dark/light with long labels and degraded data.
cases.required_behavior: Separate materials, readable contrast, keyboard use, no overflow, same semantic action/authority.

cases.title: Truthful Watch save
cases.setup: Save to nondefault list with network ambiguity.
cases.required_behavior: Owner readback/list scope; no invented success or retry on uncertain write; portfolio unchanged.

cases.title: Thesis persistence claim
cases.setup: Local notes exist but cloud episode action is unsupported.
cases.required_behavior: UI states actual durability; unsupported cloud thesis not offered until owner extension accepted.

cases.title: Alert provenance and stale delivery
cases.setup: Duplicate trigger, revoked evidence or stale queued alert.
cases.required_behavior: Existing dedupe/revocation/current validity prevents false fresh action; original delivery record preserved.

cases.title: Correlated duplicate exposure
cases.setup: Three sleeves identify one security and overlapping groups.
cases.required_behavior: One actual position lineage; opportunity views are not separate capital/independent trials.

cases.title: No feasible portfolio claim from averages
cases.setup: Candidate mean improves while liquidity/capital constraints untested.
cases.required_behavior: Only appropriate episode/policy metrics claimed; portfolio/capacity remains unproven.

cases.title: Performance and entitlement
cases.setup: Cold/warm loads, busy updates and account entitlement variants.
cases.required_behavior: Measured mobile/desktop field budgets and actual private-path response behavior; no protected cross-account cache leak.

cases.title: Rollback stale green
cases.setup: New head withdrawn while old snapshot carried ENTRY_OPEN.
cases.required_behavior: Current B4 reevaluation or unavailable action; no stale permission restored from cache.

cases.title: Source review independence
cases.setup: Old check belongs to another head or builder supplies own review.
cases.required_behavior: Exact-head evidence and genuine independent gate; preserve existing review operation and custody.

cases.title: Negative scientific result
cases.setup: Research packet fails or has inadequate power.
cases.required_behavior: Record rejected/inconclusive result without threshold shopping; protect useful unaffected product work and honest claims.

cases.title: Full US ordinary-path acceptance
cases.setup: Three initial advertised sleeves and later roadmap evaluated at release.
cases.required_behavior: Every advertised persona task and ordinary refresh proved, unresolved claims visible, regions deferred until accepted US boundary.
